title: GBRG Supply-Chain Operational-Risk Scoring Weights (declared)
description: DECLARED scoring weights, rating thresholds, control-evidence requirements, and KRI/KCI thresholds for the software supply-chain operational-risk framework, consumed (not forked) from software_supply_chain_operational_risk_framework_v0_2_bian_fico.xlsx (sheets: Weights, Controls_Evidence, KRI_KCI). Weights are DATA, never magic numbers in code: gbrg.governance.supply_chain_risk loads THIS file. Numbers are transcribed verbatim from the workbook v0.2. Adjust only after taxonomy is stable and incident data exists for calibration (per the workbook's own guidance).

inherent_risk_factors.description: Node inherent risk = weighted sum of six 0..1 factors. Weights sum to 1.0 (workbook 'Weights' sheet, 'Inherent risk factors').

criticality_K.note: Business impact if this node fails or is compromised

privilege_P.note: Ability to publish, sign, administer, or execute sensitive actions

execution_E.note: Likelihood this node can run code during install, build, or runtime

opacity_O.note: Lack of transparency, attestations, or graph visibility

concentration_C.note: Single point of failure or weak alternatives

velocity_V.note: Update frequency, churn, or operational instability

control_efficacy_families.description: Control efficacy = weighted sum of six 0..1 control-family scores (1.0 = strong control). Weights sum to 1.0 (workbook 'Weights' sheet, 'Control efficacy weights'). Each family is bound to a controls-evidence requirement below.

identity_publish.interpretation: Least privilege, MFA/OIDC trusted publishing, token hygiene

artifact_integrity.interpretation: Signing, verification, transparency logs, checksum validation

distribution_guardrails.interpretation: Mirrors, lockfiles, script suppression, index policy

monitoring_recovery.interpretation: Detection, drills, rollback, exit plans, retention

cluster_common_mode_weights.description: Common-mode / concentration cluster inherent risk = weighted sum of four 0..1 components. Weights sum to 1.0 (workbook 'Weights' sheet, 'Common-mode cluster weights').

hhi_normalized_concentration.interpretation: How concentrated the cluster is across providers

blast_radius.interpretation: How many critical services depend on the cluster

time_to_recover.interpretation: How long to restore service or integrity if the cluster fails

exit_difficulty.interpretation: How hard it is to substitute, mirror, or contractually exit

residual_model.description: Residual = inherent * (1 - control_efficacy). Path risk accumulates node residuals as a noisy-OR (1 - product(1 - residual_i)): any node on the chain failing breaks the service. Cluster residual = common_mode_inherent * (1 - resilience_control).

rating_thresholds.description: Rating from residual score. Minimum score is inclusive lower bound (workbook 'Weights' sheet, 'Rating thresholds').

controls_evidence_requirements.description: Minimum evidence checklist per control family for tier-0 services / critical nodes (workbook 'Controls_Evidence' sheet). A control-family efficacy score > 0 asserted with NO evidence reference is UNVERIFIABLE and fails closed.

Governance.objective: Assign ownership, exceptions, and change authority for critical services and nodes.
Governance.tier0_minimum: Owner and exception process documented for every tier-0 node and path.

Identity & publishing authority.objective: Reduce credential risk and uncontrolled publish authority.
Identity & publishing authority.tier0_minimum: No long-lived publish tokens on tier-0 CI/CD paths; MFA or equivalent for all high-authority identities.
Identity & publishing authority.mapped_frameworks: BCBS third-party / NIST SSDF / npm trusted publishing

Build provenance.objective: Capture where, when, and how artifacts were produced.
Build provenance.tier0_minimum: Verified provenance for 100% of tier-0 releases.

Artifact integrity.objective: Bind artifacts to identity and make verification auditable.
Artifact integrity.tier0_minimum: All tier-0 artifacts signed and verification enforced before promotion.

Distribution guardrails.objective: Constrain risky install and update behavior.
Distribution guardrails.tier0_minimum: Tier-0 builds and releases install only from approved channels with lock/pin policy.

Monitoring & recovery.objective: Detect failures early and recover or roll back fast.
Monitoring & recovery.tier0_minimum: Recovery playbook tested for every tier-0 service at least quarterly.

kri_kci_thresholds.description: Key risk indicators (KRIs) and key control indicators (KCIs) with green/amber/red bands (workbook 'KRI_KCI' sheet). A metric landing RED is a threshold breach: a path/node whose KRI evaluates RED is FLAGGED and the assessment is not VERIFIED (fail-closed). Bands with a % or numeric direction are encoded as machine-checkable comparators.

indicators.metric: Tier-0 artifacts with signature verification enforced
Tier-0 paths allowing install-time script execution
Critical nodes without tested exit plan
Tier-0 builds on isolated / ephemeral builders
Critical dependencies with SBOM and graph visibility
Critical services with tested recovery drill
Critical providers with current due diligence review
